title: Poorest countries by GDP per capita
hook: Tracing how the countries with the lowest GDP per capita shift over time.
setup: This animation reveals the economies ranking at the bottom of the distribution from 1990 to 2025.

sequence.text: Mozambique starts as the country with the lowest GDP per capita at 547.62 USD.
Cambodia appears in the ranking as a newcomer.
Ethiopia takes the lead with a value of 838.3 USD.
Burundi takes the lead with a value of 995.03 USD.
Sudan appears in the ranking as a newcomer.

highlights.headline: Lowest GDP per capita
highlights.detail: Mozambique records the lowest GDP per capita in 1990 at 547.62 USD.

ending: A look at the nations maintaining the lowest GDP per capita across decades.
